text.b: APPLICATION FOR DATA ENGINEER (MICROSOFT FABRIC & AZURE) at SRKK

page.text: I am applying for the Data Engineer role focused on Microsoft Fabric and Azure. I hold a Computer Science degree from
Universiti Sains Malaysia and gained practical engineering experience through a fintech internship. I am currently
pursuing a flexible online MBA at INTI and am available for full-time work.
My interest in the data engineering role comes from seeing the work, insights, and career trajectory of my friends in this
industry, which made me realise that a lot of enterprise-level companies are hitting real bottlenecks in how they move
and manage their data, and that there are big opportunities and advantages for those who have expertise in data platforms
as a data engineer in the industry. I also see how fast on-trend data platforms like Snowflake, Databricks and Microsoft
Fabric have grown, which tells me the AI wave is being built on top of data platforms rather than beside them.
Therefore, the data engineering role at SRKK drives my intention to apply, as it has more room to grow and to step
further in my future career path.
2. My last working experience was a Software Engineer internship at iFAST Capital, inside a regulated fintech delivery
team. Sitting between business change and engineering taught me that requirements come first and the technical
work follows, and that trust comes from listening carefully, agreeing clearly, and staying accountable through
release. That is the habit I want to bring into a consulting data team.
3. Besides that, I am interested in diving into the stacks in this role that align with my future career direction, while AI
remains my personal passion, and my own AI projects have taken me deep into agentic tools that I am interested in
integrating into the data platform workflow to leverage my capabilities in this industry based on the emerging AI
skill sets I have learned and applied. I have been getting hands-on with, and practically applying them to design,
implement, review and ship day to day. Especially in the part where I want to utilise the full potential of an agent
harness like Claude Code to contribute to the data engineering job scope in this role. Another attraction point for me
to look into this role is the opportunity and exposure to consulting experience that can handle real business problems
of enterprise clients from different domains end-to-end, including communicating with customers, pitching clearly,
and handling relationships, which sharpens my soft skills and accumulates the skill set to be a successful data
engineer with strong business knowledge and insights that align with the picture of my future career path. Also, the
friend who referred me spoke well of the culture and the room to grow. That is why I think SRKK is my first-choice
place to become the data engineer I want to be.
4. From the USA Work & Travel program I worked for six months beside colleagues from more than ten nationalities
and earned two Honorable Mentions for client-facing problem solving. In hackathons, Champion titles, second
prizes and multiple awards taught me to catch up in a fast-paced environment, own every detail of the work, and
present under time pressure. Requires precision on the details, challenging working attributes that always make sure
deliverables finished on time, is always what I have been working with and familiar. If you are open to a junior
engineer who is familiar with AI skillsets and agentic tools that wants to dive deep into the enterprise data engineer
role, I would like to talk.
Thank you in advance for your kind consideration.
Sincerely,
Bachelor of Computer Science (Honours)
Universiti Sains Malaysia
